## Caveats (honest blind spots)

- Use web_extract on promising URLs; search results are leads, not evidence.
- Use x_search if Hermes has it configured; otherwise use Nitter or site:x.com search. Do not use cookie auth without approval.
- Prefer Redlib/reddit-search first; browser/cookie auth requires approval.
- No dedicated TikTok reader is configured by default. Use site:tiktok.com search first; account/session browser work needs approval.
- No dedicated Instagram reader is configured by default. Use site:instagram.com search first; account/session browser work needs approval.
- Use media/transcript tools when available; install yt-dlp only in a project venv when needed.
- Use GitHub MCP first when available; gh CLI for terminal/git workflows.
